punchline: A former nun asked a delivery man if he spoke French, and a life changed course.
thirty_sec: Deo Niyizonkiza, a Burundian refugee, delivered groceries in New York and had slept in Central Park. At 22 he met Sharon McKenna at a church rectory; she asked if he spoke French, tipped him and hugged him, then found a couple who took him in.
question: Who do you meet every week only through their job, and what one real question could you ask them next time?
key_contrast: She saw a person, not a delivery.
